rule_summary: Occupation generally turns on effective control over territory by hostile armed forces rather than formal annexation.
key_authorities: Hague Regulations; Geneva Convention IV; ICJ Wall Advisory Opinion

rule_summary: Occupying power must restore and ensure public order and civil life while respecting existing laws unless absolutely prevented.
Occupation does not transfer sovereignty and should not become a project of annexation, settlement, or permanent domination.
key_authorities: Hague Regulations; Geneva Convention IV; ICJ 2024 OPT Advisory Opinion

rule_summary: Protected persons retain humanitarian protections against coercion, collective punishment, deportation, transfer, and unlawful confinement.
Private property, public property, resources, and economic administration are constrained by usufruct, necessity, and humanitarian duties.
key_authorities: Hague Regulations; Geneva Convention IV; Customary IHL
